prompt: Complete the Person class so it implements the two provided interfaces Named and Aged, storing a name and an age, and add a summary() method that combines them like "Ada (36)".
explanation: A class can implement any number of interfaces; it simply has to provide a body for every abstract method each interface declares. Interface methods are implicitly public, so the implementations must be declared public too. Once Person implements Named and Aged, a Person object can be stored in a variable of either interface type, and instanceof reports true for both.
hints: Declare private final String name and private final int age, and assign them with this.name = name; this.age = age; in the constructor.
The implementing methods must be public -- interface methods are always public.
summary() can just reuse your own methods: return name() + " (" + age() + ")";
